mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits carbamazepine metabolism via CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, increasing carbamazepine levels and toxicity risk; carbamazepine induces isoniazid metabolism, reducing isoniazid efficacy.
action: Monitor carbamazepine levels closely; reduce carbamazepine dose by 25-30% if co-prescribed; monitor for toxicity signs (ataxia, diplopia, dizziness) and ensure adequate TB control.
